svg.title: Six layers of checks
svg.desc: Six layers in order: The build: 961 quotes of Marcus, each one exact span of its passage; 1,444 passage revisions hashed; Acceptance gates: 0 blocking findings over all 38 articles; 73 warnings for a person to read; Independent review: 18 of 19 reviews through the API sent the article back; the one that accepted was Article 18’s second; Reading across: 79 findings: 68 overlaps, 7 contradictions, 4 labels; Tests: npm test every quote resolves, counts agree, both languages complete; Browser check: 360 · 390 · 1440 px wide, EN and RU, with and without Seneca; no text under 12 px.
svg.text: Four before an article enters the record (two

two on the page: tests and a browser.
